intent: Browser-based React/Vite + Fastify web app on 127.0.0.1, not a Windows desktop application. Keep verified Windows CI results as historical evidence; do not require Windows 11 for release.

scope.deployment: user-run localhost server; no Electron, EXE, native Windows application or Windows installer requirement
scope.hostPolicy: At least one declared supported local host OS with real dependencies and browser acceptance; OS-specific smoke is compatibility evidence, not a Windows 11 release prerequisite.
scope.platforms: Windows/Linux/macOS where actual FFmpeg, HyperFrames, Node and any configured local AI provider are supported. Do not claim an OS validated until tested.
scope.aiPolicy: Actual model inference only for locally configured providers and explicitly consented remote providers; local GPU required only for features configured to use it.
scope.historyPolicy: Keep historical Windows Server 2022 CI facts, PR/test runs, unmodified source backlog and reference roadmap for audit; supersede their platform constraints in this generated backlog.
scope.releasePolicy: NOT_READY until objective browser, render, performance, security, and selected-provider gates pass; no code-only PASS is production acceptance.

remainingGate: Compare real Remotion vs HyperFrames only if changing renderer or seeking a measured performance improvement; both engines must run on the same supported local host with identical fixtures
Measure runtime, peak memory, FFprobe, glyph/music quality, and licenses; keep HyperFrames as current primary until evidence justifies a change

FI-04-01.title: Bounded cross-platform test suite, repeated soak and hang diagnosis
remainingGate: Run full deterministic suite with retries/soak on supported local host or CI; determine whether historical intermittent FFmpeg hang recurs
Report timeouts, watchdog, stable exit codes and evidence, not only a passing isolated test

FI-04-02.title: Reproducible local Node/npm dependencies and pinned renderer toolchain
remainingGate: Verify reviewed package-lock.json with npm ci, exact local HyperFrames and pinned FFmpeg/FFprobe on a supported host OS
Review dependency security and platform-specific availability; never silently install unknown binaries

FI-04-03.title: Localhost web bootstrap: Vite build, Fastify loopback, authenticated browser
remainingGate: Start production Fastify over 127.0.0.1 with real SQLite and verified static Vite build; test lifecycle, auth and browser asset loading
Prove actual interactive browser behavior, not only a headless pairing-page DOM

FI-04-04.title: Real local HyperFrames five-scene MP4 with Vietnamese subtitles and music
remainingGate: Review recorded five-scene MP4 for legible Vietnamese glyphs, audible selected music, voice and correct timing
Repeat with actual local browser-triggered SP-04 job on supported host; 35-minute render is a separate task

FI-04-05.title: Authenticated localhost Timeline UX, trim, reorder, waveform and scale
remainingGate: Use authenticated localhost browser UI to witness drag/reorder, trim save/cancel, undo/redo, waveform, zoom and one-audio-track behavior
Measure 120/500-scene viewport responsiveness and A/V seeking in a real supported browser

FI-04-06.title: Real 35–40-minute Full HD HyperFrames export through localhost web app
remainingGate: Render an approved real 2100–2400-second 1080p Composition v2 using the local SP-04 queue and exact pinned HyperFrames on supported host
Validate MP4 H.264/AAC frame count, voice sync, Vietnamese captions/SRT, music and manual audiovisual quality
Capture encode walltime, child CPU/RAM, disk usage and GPU/VRAM only when GPU is used

FI-04-07.title: Local render process interruption, durable job recovery and output integrity
remainingGate: Actually terminate a live 35+ minute local renderer child and restart server/worker; verify lease fencing and safe retry
Prove no partial MP4 published and checksum/FFprobe/voice/subtitle/music QA of recovered output

FI-04-08.title: Configured local AI LLM/TTS/ComfyUI E2E and explicit consent safeguards
remainingGate: For each enabled local provider, run actual LLM/TTS/image/video inference with captured quality and resource evidence; GPU is conditional on configured workflow
Verify quota/429 behavior, local-only routing, explicit approval for any remote or paid provider, and zero unauthorized charges
Maintain separate acceptance when model/GPU is unavailable instead of blocking unrelated browser/edit/import flows

FI-04-09.title: Localhost security, dependency audit and realistic media performance
remainingGate: Review loopback binding, authenticated private media, secrets at rest/process, path traversal, import limits, child process isolation and dependency audit
Profile real long render peak CPU/RAM/GPU (when present), disk/ENOSPC, 500 scenes, and browser responsiveness

FI-04-10.title: Evidence-based localhost release matrix and explicit approval
remainingGate: Collect fresh successful CI plus live local browser, real HyperFrames MP4/35min, recovery, security and performance evidence
Require human voice/subtitle/music and end-to-end interaction signoff; if AI video release profile is chosen, require genuine GPU-produced clip
Release remains NOT_READY until all gates for selected profile are verified; preserve opt-in paid policy

WI-01.title: Local host prerequisites and fail-closed diagnostics (legacy WI-01 ID)
remainingGate: Report Node/npm lock, FFmpeg/FFprobe, HyperFrames, browser, loopback and filesystem readiness on actual supported local host
Any existing PowerShell-only check is a platform-specific helper, never mandatory for a web release on a different OS

WI-02.title: Local web server launch, Vite build and Fastify loopback verification (legacy WI-02 ID)
remainingGate: Verify reproducible npm ci + Vite static build and authenticated real Fastify HTTP/SQLite lifecycle on declared supported host
Run React UI on localhost in a real browser; no Windows installer/EXE or native desktop shell is required

WI-03.title: Hosted CI compatibility evidence and browser integration verification (legacy WI-03 ID)
remainingGate: Perform authenticated real browser Timeline/Edit/Render interactions against localhost on at least one supported host
Prove five-scene HyperFrames media, 35-minute job/recovery and configured AI separately; hosted Windows pairing-page evidence is historical only

milestones.name: MVP_localhost
milestones.note: Browser-based local server, edits, genuine HyperFrames 35–40 min MP4, recovery, security and performance; no fixed Windows 11 prerequisite or local GPU if using imported media.

milestones.name: AI_video_local
milestones.note: Additional selected-profile acceptance for real ComfyUI/Wan model-produced footage, correct provenance, GPU/VRAM benchmark and 35min hybrid export.

milestones.name: Optional_extensions
milestones.note: Not part of MVP. Paid provider integrations require explicit opt-in, official pricing, security and consent review.
